title: Microburst token impact harness: per-step timing & prefetch variance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, reproducible harness and telemetry schema to attribute short-lived (microburst) token latency/cost spikes to specific internal stages (prefetch, KV lookup, kernel invocation, batching delay). Deliverables: (1) trace hooks and lightweight per-step timers instrumented in the emission path that emit compact spans suitable for high-cardinality sampling; (2) a metrics/log pipeline mapping to a token-attribution event type (sparkline + bucketed delta) for aggregation in the console; (3) a local simulator to replay request shapes and prefetch/batching variance to validate attribution accuracy and expected billing adjustments. Goal: reduce incident time-to-root-cause for bursty token regressions and enable cost adjustments attributed to cache miss/prefetch variance.
updates: 2026-02-28 - Kickoff: scoped to emission path (request ingress -> batching -> kernel), agreed to use compact span tags to limit cardinality.
2026-03-03 - Design review: chose 3 per-token timers (enqueue->dispatch, dispatch->kernel-start, kernel-start->emit) plus a prefetch decision tag; PM requested aggregate sparkline output for Console.
2026-03-05 - Spike: implemented prototype hooks in serving runtime (local only). Observed ~0.4ms overhead on p50 for tiny tokens; sampling rate set to 1% by default.
2026-03-08 - Telemetry mapping: finalized schema and agreed on metric names and tag set with observability infra; added histogram buckets for microburst detection.
2026-03-10 - Validation: ran harness replay of 1k synthetic bursts, attribution matched simulated prefetch misses in 92% of runs; logging format adjusted to include cache-hit boolean.
comments: PM (Jonah Kim): Need console prototype showing per-route microburst sparklines before cycle demo.
Infra (Lina Zhou): Keep cardinality low — prefer boolean flags and binned durations, not raw token ids.
Eng (Mateo Ruiz): Will open PR for runtime hooks and separate PR for pipeline transforms; request a short on-call runbook for investigating token microbursts.
Design note: Console sparkline should show both p50/p95 and a small heatmap of cache-hit ratio per-minute.
QA (Priya Menon): Add tests that assert attribution remains stable under 10k concurrent synthetic requests.
